fields.summary: Store race: concurrent writes drop one edit
fields.description:
Concurrent `Store.write` to the same note file drops one edit. `O_TRUNC` without flock; second writer truncates before first writer's bytes hit disk.

Fix: `renameat2(RENAME_EXCHANGE)` where available, `.tmp + rename` elsewhere. Per-note-id lock.

Full writeup: `.mnml/findings/store-race-2026-08-08.md`.

comments.body: Nasty. This is why the R2 tester saw a note revert to yesterday's content.
Have a repro in `src/store.test.ts` (concurrent write test). Working on the rename fix on branch fix/store-race.
